name: Bing report a concern

search.notes: Search Bing for the name with a city to collect result URLs.

steps: Open the Bing report a concern page.
Pick the category that matches private info or doxxing.
Paste each result URL and describe the personal info shown.
Submit and keep any reference number.
optout.notes: For people outside Europe, or for concerns that are not right to be forgotten requests. Bing's own Europe form links here for other concerns.

sources.attribution: Microsoft Bing, link on the Europe form

verification_note: Link taken from Bing's Europe form on 2026-10-27. The page is a script app that did not render for a plain fetch, so its categories were not confirmed.
